findings.title: W9 surge-lands pin: counters span the whole run (ticks 1..3000) while the floor/bounds are window-sized — the pinned ×0.95 is effectively ×0.88 in-window
findings.detail: stream_spawned + per_host_spawns accumulate from tick 1, adding up to ~1199 pre-window base spawns of slack against the window-sized MIN_LAND 17100 — the in-window floor is ~15900 ≈ 0.88×expected, not the card's 0.95. The per-host bound (ceil_cap + accrue×WINDOW/1000) is likewise window-sized while its counter is run-scoped (scope mismatch — cannot false-fire on the pinned seed, but imprecise). NON-VACUOUS still: a silently non-landing surge (~3-5k total) fails decisively. Contract-vs-pin gap: warning.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate both counters on tick >= SURGE_START (or subtract the pre-window tally) so the 17100 floor and the per-host bound are window-scoped as the card pins.

findings.title: cap_fraction_permille in [1,5] truncates residential accrual to 0 — the type becomes permanently spawn-ineligible INSIDE the validated 1..1000 range
findings.evidence:
dividend := i64(cat.balance.cap_fraction_permille) * i64(nt.throughput_units)
	return u32(dividend / i64(cat.balance.packet_bandwidth))
findings.detail: accrue = f×5÷30 truncates to 0 for f ∈ [1,5] (f=5: 25÷30=0): residential credit never reaches 1000, the eligible set is always empty for it, and residential-sourced demand silently dies — a validated catalog value, no load error. The range-check comment considered 0 ('gates nothing') but missed small-f ('gates everything' for low-throughput types). Shipped value 500 is fine; this is an ODN-5 fail-fast gap at the tuning boundary.
findings.recommended_fix: Fail-fast at load when any terminal type's accrual truncates to 0 with fraction > 0 (or document the floor in the range-check message).

findings.title: health_test's re-pinned latency-enter assertion is guarded by win_delivered > 0 — the avg>500 check can silently skip
findings.detail: The enter-metric assertion skips entirely at zero deliveries. Mitigated: s.health.breach[0] is asserted unconditionally two lines above, so a dead scenario still goes red (no-breach) — the composite pin is non-vacuous, but the metric check itself should assert the delivery count explicitly (the W10 pin pattern).
findings.recommended_fix: Add testing.expect(t, s.health.win_delivered[0] > 0) before the avg check.

findings.title: throughput_units is unvalidated (jint, default 0, no bounds) and now feeds wrap-prone u32 credit math
findings.detail: No range check on throughput_units exists (pre-existing load, NEW consumer): a negative value wraps u32() to ~4.29e9 accrual; a huge value overflows the u32 narrowing after the i64 division. Shipped catalogs are sane (80/5) and every T1 would shift on a bad edit, so practical risk is low — but 5.9 made this a state-math input; ODN-5 fail-fast would bound it like the other tunables.
findings.recommended_fix: Fail-fast throughput_units to a sane positive range for terminal types at load.

findings.title: Credit is consumed before the sink pick; the !okd sink-skip path burns 1000 credit with no spawn — undocumented sub-case

findings.detail: A terminal whose sink set is only itself burns 1000/ask forever (credit oscillates; no spawns — same as pre-5.9, no demand event, E24 intact). findings.recommended_fix: Comment the !okd burn as an asked-but-unservable ask (no refund, by design).
